patterns.description: The slide is organized as a two-section content layout: a goals section with icon-plus-text items and a solutions section with repeated text cards.
Goal items appear as repeated units combining a fixed icon badge and an editable text label.
Solution cards are repeated editable text boxes arranged horizontally.
Branding logos are present in the bottom corners and appear to be fixed layout/master assets rather than slide content.
Large background images and thin connector lines are inherited from the layout/master and function as decorative chrome.

constraints.description: Bottom-corner logos should be treated as fixed branding and preserved rather than replaced as content.
Inherited master/layout decorative connectors and background images are not editable content slots.
